node_branches.Log: unary log for absent base; binary logBase for present base

length_units.unsupported: All other LengthUnit variants: viewport, container, internal character width; future variants also use None

arity_notes: Operator metadata (min vs max, rounding mode, clamping mode, mod vs rem) does not alter eager child visitation.
The optional Log base is represented by unary or binary shape, preserving actual absence/presence.
Variadic lists include arbitrary finite lengths; the parser can impose stricter arities.
Unsupported whole nodes produce one unsupported event without modeling their contents; support is already unknown.
Magnitude, numeric typing and simplification are erased; the input is the retained AST after actual admission.
